prompt: Review PR 508 for the catalog API. The change adds a read-through in-memory cache around price-list reads, and it matters now because this service handles multiple tenants while the nightly import and sales traffic are increasing. Read the repository at the project root, including the author's description in pr/508/description.md and the exact patch in pr/508/changes.diff. Check that the implementation preserves the behavior documented by the project and that the tests and configuration still make sense together. Write the review to REVIEW.md at the top of the project. End it with a fenced json list of findings, each with location (path/to/file.ext:LINE, with line numbers of the file as it is in the project), severity (critical, high, medium, low or nit), issue and fix.

checks.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const t=fs.readFileSync("REVIEW.md","utf8");let L=null;for(const m of t.matchAll(/^\x60\x60\x60([a-z]*)[ \t]*\n([\s\S]*?)^\x60\x60\x60[ \t]*$/gim)){if(m[1]&&m[1].toLowerCase()!=="json")continue;let d;try{d=JSON.parse(m[2])}catch{continue}const l=Array.isArray(d)?d:Array.isArray(d&&d.findings)?d.findings:null;if(l&&l.every(x=>x&&typeof x==="object"&&!Array.isArray(x))){L=l;break}}if(!L||!L.length)process.exit(1);const S=["critical","high","medium","low","nit"];process.exit(L.every(x=>x.location&&S.includes(String(x.severity).toLowerCase())&&(x.issue||x.fix||x.text))?0:1)'

node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const t=fs.readFileSync("REVIEW.md","utf8");let L=null;for(const m of t.matchAll(/^\x60\x60\x60([a-z]*)[ \t]*\n([\s\S]*?)^\x60\x60\x60[ \t]*$/gim)){if(m[1]&&m[1].toLowerCase()!=="json")continue;let d;try{d=JSON.parse(m[2])}catch{continue}const l=Array.isArray(d)?d:Array.isArray(d&&d.findings)?d.findings:null;if(l&&l.every(x=>x&&typeof x==="object"&&!Array.isArray(x))){L=l;break}}if(!L||!L.length)process.exit(1);let n=0;for(const x of L)for(const m of String(x.location).matchAll(/([A-Za-z0-9_.\/-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9]+):(\d+)/g)){n++;let c;try{c=fs.readFileSync(m[1],"utf8").split("\n").length}catch{process.exit(1)}if(+m[2]<1||+m[2]>c)process.exit(1)}process.exit(n?0:1)'

rubric.criterion: Each important finding states the concrete consequence in this catalog service and gives a fix a developer can act on, without inventing problems that the code does not support. Fail: generic findings ("add validation", "consider security"), or a finding the packet does not support. Partial: findings are grounded in the packet but some lack an actionable fix or a concrete consequence. Pass: every important finding names the place, the concrete consequence in this project and a fix a developer can build, and no finding is invented. (code cannot check this because it cannot judge the accuracy or usefulness of the reviewer's explanation).

findingsKey.finding: The cache lookup uses only the price-list id, so a hit populated by one tenant can be returned to another tenant and expose the wrong prices.
Bulk replacement writes new prices without invalidating the cached list, so reads can continue serving stale prices after the nightly import.
The configured TTL is named and stored in seconds but is passed into a cache setter that interprets the value as milliseconds, making the advertised 30-second lifetime about 30 milliseconds.
Every concurrent miss independently calls the JSON store because the loader does not share an in-flight promise, creating a burst of duplicate reads under the documented import traffic.
Cache hits return the stored object directly, so a caller that edits a price response mutates the cached value and changes later responses without a store write.
The configured maximum is saved and reported but set never evicts entries, allowing the process cache to grow without the documented memory ceiling.
